reasoning: A hybrid approach combines autonomous pattern recognition with external XAI tools to robustly identify shared spurious features. tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP identifies high-impact features across instances, with intersection mode highlighting shared features driving misclassification. LIME provides local interpretability, confirming whether feature importance persists in local prediction contexts. Integrated gradients quantify attribution strength via gradients, offering a gradient-based view of model reliance. Sensitivity analysis isolates features whose removal changes predictions significantly, identifying spurious ones. Together, they validate and pinpoint shared spurious columns that are both influential and semantically irrelevant.
